references.title: What last heating season cost
references.body: Two propane fills and three cords of ash, read off the statements for November through March. Propane came to six hundred and twelve dollars across the two fills, and the wood to five hundred and forty. Nothing here is a forecast for this winter; it is what the paper said about the last one.

questions.title: How much is the deposit on the hired press
questions.reason: The orchard took a deposit in cash and wrote no figure in the notebook, so the account for it carries no amount at all.

questions.title: Why did the escrow go up in the last letter
questions.reason: The payment rose by thirty one dollars and the letter does not say whether that is the town rate or the insurance. One telephone call would settle it.
